rules.name: Claude Code doesn't use the company gateway
rules.why: env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in {file} isn't the company gateway, so prompts and code leave without its logging and data controls.

rules.name: A project lets Claude Code run the deploy script without asking
rules.why: permissions.allow in {file} approves the deploy script ahead of time, so a prompt injection can ship to production.
rules.fix: Remove the deploy script from permissions.allow in {file}. Deploys go through the release pipeline.
